scope: Operational acceptance and rollback note; not a code-policy change
source_design: Three attempts and a30second eligibility window bound cooperative retries. They do not guarantee recovery from a34second or longer mutation wave.
intentional_compatibility_change: After exhausted source_changed, normal rerender and old2second errorTTL no longer re-admit. Explicit matching manual retry is required. This can leave a terminal page unavailable after data becomes quiet, unlike prior passive healing.
rollback_consideration: Persistent page unavailability after sufficient retained evidence of source quiescence is a rollback trigger even if process/HTTP health is good. Preserve the failed observation regardless of rollback.
evidence_rules: Separate retry_exhausted terminal outcomes from queued/pending work.
A cycle-completion timestamp alone is a proxy, not proof that every source stopped changing.
Use retained post-mutation/post-cycle request outcomes and available generation diagnostics; if quiet-period coverage is insufficient, mark recovery unqualified.
Do not expand retry attempts/duration, weaken verification or introduce extra production load to manufacture a pass.
source_qa_claim: Correctness of the finite policy only. Operational suitability still requires the new bounded production observation.
